description.value: Sungiven Foods is a Metro Vancouver supermarket chain with a focus on globally sourced, minimally processed foods — particularly strong in Asian ingredients, fresh seafood, and premium meats including Angus beef, Berkshire pork, and free-range chicken. The Burnaby location on Hastings Street is one of several stores across the region, making it a practical resupply stop for touring cyclists on the North Burnaby corridor. A dedicated 'Sungiven Kitchen' ready-to-eat section offers a rotating selection of prepared Asian dishes for riders looking for a quick meal.
